title: Watercolor "Sunny Side Up" 568 East Royal Fern Way
h1: Watercolor "Sunny Side Up" 568 East Royal Fern Way
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 12 wristbands.- Private Heated Pool and Sitting Spa. The pool and spa are heated together. **Pool heating is available for this property from October 1st through May 1st for $45 per day**- 6- Passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- Screened In Porch- Minutes from Publix- 5 Adult Bikes - Professionally Decorated - This property comes with 3 dedicated parking spots. Additional parking can be found throughout the community. - Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout. Guests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Enjoy the "Sunny Side Up" during your next luxurious WaterColor getaway! 568 East Royal Fern Way is a stunning home and offers 5 bedrooms, 5 bathrooms, and exquisite accommodations for 12 guests.The living room offers plush furnishings and a welcoming place to unwind. Home cooks and foodies will love this exquisite and well-appointed kitchen. The countertops feature stunning inlaid sea glass, and premium stainless steel appliances make this kitchen a fabulous place to prepare family vacation meals. Four seats at the breakfast bar and 8 seats in the nearby dining area offer ample space for guests to enjoy mealtimes. Also on the first floor is a beautiful king bed guestroom and a shared bathroom with a glass-front shower.On the second floor are three lovely guestrooms. Guests in the primary suite will enjoy a luxurious upholstered king bed and a private en suite bathroom with a shower, a dual-sink vanity, and a separate soaking tub. The final two guestrooms in the main house are a king bed guestroom with a private bathroom and shower/tub combo, and a queen bed guestroom with a private bathroom and a shower.The carriage house boasts wonderful accommodations for guests seeking a little more privacy. This area features a kitchenette with a stove, dishwasher, microwave, and mini refrigerator. A comfortable queen sleeper sofa offers sleeping accommodations in the living area, and the guest bedroom boasts a queen bed and a shared bathroom with a single vanity and a glass-front shower.The spacious screened porch provides a shaded place to relax. A sparkling pool - which can be heated seasonally from October to May - and adjoining sitting spa create a beautiful oasis in the backyard. Guests will enjoy this home's convenient location - just minutes from Publix and close to the sugar white sand beach and sparkling emerald waters!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 12):FIRST FLOOR: -Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo -Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only CARRIAGE HOUSE:-Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only-Living Area: Queen Sleeper*The fireplace is not for guest use*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to fines.Please note: Effective March 15, 2014, Low-Speed Vehicle rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 80 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Only one cart may be rented per home and rentals will be granted on a first-come, first-served basis.

DETAILS: Enjoy the "Sunny Side Up" during your next luxurious WaterColor getaway! 568 East Royal Fern Way is a stunning home and offers 5 bedrooms, 5 bathrooms, and exquisite accommodations for 12 guests. The living room offers plush furnishings and a welcoming place to unwind. Home cooks and foodies will love this exquisite and well-appointed kitchen. The countertops feature stunning inlaid sea glass, and premium stainless steel appliances make this kitchen a fabulous place to prepare family vacation meals. The final two guestrooms in the main house are a king bed guestroom with a private bathroom and shower/tub combo, and a queen bed guestroom with a private bathroom and a shower. The carriage house boasts wonderful accommodations for guests seeking a little more privacy. This area features a kitchenette with a stove, dishwasher, microwave, and mini refrigerator. A comfortable queen sleeper sofa offers sleeping accommodations in the living area, and the guest bedroom boasts a queen bed and a shared bathroom with a single vanity and a glass-front shower. The spacious screened porch provides a shaded place to relax. A sparkling pool - which can be heated seasonally from October to May - and adjoining sitting spa create a beautiful oasis in the backyard. Guests will enjoy this home's convenient location - just minutes from Publix and close to the sugar white sand beach and sparkling emerald waters!
